title: Coordinate replacement
statement: Let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, choose a coordinate $i$, and choose a sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$. The coordinate replacement of $x$ is the Boolean-cube point that has value $b$ at coordinate $i$ and agrees with $x$ at every other coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a point of the Boolean cube
